Powered by Reelgood Dan Fogelman’s hit post-apocalyptic thriller Paradise returned to Hulu for Season 2 in February, answering Season 1’s burning questions and introducing us to a new group of characters from outside of the bunker. In Season 1, we watched Secret Service Agent Xavier Collins (Sterling K. Brown) attempt to solve the murder of President Cal Bradford (James Marsden) while trying to prove his innocence in the crime. The season finale ended with the reveal of Bradford’s murderer and Collins leaving the bunker to find his wife Teri and others who may have survived the apocalyptic disaster. Brown, Marsden, and Julianne Nicholson, who plays Samantha “Sinatra” Redmond, all earned Emmy nominations for their performances, and the series was nominated for Outstanding Drama. Season 2 begins back in time on the day of the disaster, introducing us to Annie Clay (Shailene Woodley), a tour guide at Graceland in Memphis. The seventh episode of Paradise S2 premiered today, but if you’re curious about how many more episodes are left in the season, here’s what to expect. How Many Episodes Will Paradise Season 2 Have? There is one more episode left in Paradise Season 2, bringing the total to eight episodes. What Time Do Episodes Of Paradise Season 2 Drop? New episodes of Paradise Season 2 drop on Mondays at 12 a.m. ET, and for West Coasters, Sundays at 9 p.m. PT. When Do New Episodes Of Paradise Season 2 Premiere: Episode Release Guide New episodes of Paradise Season 2 were being released weekly, so here a guide to remind you of what episodes aired when. If you want to read Decider’s Paradise recap for any given episode, simply click on any of the hyperlinks below: Season 2, Episode 1: Monday, February 23 (“Graceland“) Season 2, Episode 2: Monday, February 23 (“Mayday“) Season 2, Episode 3: Monday, February 23 (“Another Day in Paradise“) Season 2, Episode 4: Monday, March 2 (“A Holy Charge“) Season 2, Episode 5: Monday, March 9 (“The Mailman“) Season 2, Episode 6: Monday, March 16 (“Jane“) Season 2, Episode 7: Monday, March 23 (“The Final Countdown”) Season 2, Episode 8: Monday, March 30 (“Exodus”) Is There A Paradise Season 2 Trailer? If you’re looking for a trailer for Season 2, we’ve got you covered. The Season 2 trailer, which dropped in January, can be found at the top of this article. Will There Be A Paradise Season 3? We’ve got good news and we’ve got bad news. The good news is that YES, there will be a Paradise Season 3; Hulu officially renewed the popular series for its third season last week. So then what’s the bad news? Well, the renewal came with the caveat that the show will be wrapping up after the events of Season 3. How To Watch Paradise Season 2 Online: Paradise is a Hulu original series, which means you’ll need a Hulu subscription to watch. If you’re new to Hulu, you can get started with a 30-day free trial on the streamer’s basic (with ads) plan. After the trial period, you’ll pay $10.99/month. If you want to upgrade to Hulu ad-free, it costs $18.99/month. If you want to stream even more and save a few bucks a month while you’re at it, we recommend subscribing to one of the Disney+ Bundles, all of which include Hulu. These bundles start at $12.99/month for ad-supported Disney+ and Hulu and goes up to $32.99/month for Disney+, Hulu, and Max, all ad-free. Tags Hulu Paradise sterling k. brown
